title: Delete Node in a BST
goal: Solve Delete Node in a BST: Locate the BST key and preserve ordering while replacing a deleted node with its child or an inorder successor.
strategy: Locate the BST key and preserve ordering while replacing a deleted node with its child or an inorder successor.
edgeCases: Deleting the root can change the tree head; a node with two children needs ordered replacement rather than simple unlinking.
